body: I wasn't sure if they were going in a professional capacity or if it was just for fun.

subject: YES!
author: ZombieTron
body:
At least it's a bit more exciting then them heading anywhere else! :)

Aren't you excited to see what CG are working on?????

subject: And the good news is...
author: hn6
body: ...on the plus side this would make a new Burnout an ideal candidate for the next generation of hardware, especially as Criterion have always been tech led and could be a shoe in for showing off what the next gen has to offer.

subject: Dashed hopes?
author: ZombieTron
body:
Well, NFS: Most Wanted has been announced as what Criterion Games are doing, so our hopes have been dashed.

At least I have a couple of days to get used to it before the E3 press conference.

I did quite like the last Most Wanted, until Hot Pursuit and The Run it was the NFS game I had played most.

I'm looking forward to seeing it in motion and hearing more about it. At least we know we won't have long to wait for it to be released! :)

subject: I'm going to get my hopes up
author: Pappy Knuckles
body: I'm going to get my hopes up prematurely and believe that they're going there to announce a new Burnout. I'm sure I'll be disappointed, but a guy can dream...
